heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Is end-to-end encryption available?
items.answer: Yes. We can implement it where privacy requirements call for it.

items.question: Can the chat scale to many users?
items.answer: Yes. We use scalable real-time infrastructure.

items.question: Can I add chat to an existing app?
items.answer: Yes. Chat can be added to existing iOS, Android and web apps.

items.question: How long does instant messaging app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
